newsitem.title: USA: International Equity to sell major stake.
newsitem.headline: International Equity to sell major stake.

text.p: International Equity Resources Inc said Wednesday it agreed to sell a total of 20 million shares of its common stock to Kyoto Securities Ltd for a total of $20 million.
The agreement requires the stock to be purchased in five blocks.
A spokesman said International Equity has 25 million shares authorized and 4.4 million shares outstanding. The agreement would make Kyoto the company's controlling shareholder.

International Equity said the first block of 500,000 shares must be purchased by March 20 and the second block of 4.5 million shares by June 30. The remaining three blocks of five million shares each must be purchased by December 31, 1997, June 30, 1998, and December 31, 1998, it said.
If any of the blocks were not purchased on a timely basis, International Equity said it may increase the price to $1.10 a share.
The company said it plans to use the proceeds to make one or more acquisitions, either domestically or internationally. No specific industry has yet been identified, it added.
The agreement requires Kyoto to purchase all remaining blocks of stock within 90 days, plus a 30-day grace period, after an acquisition candidate company is presented.
Kyoto loses the right to purchase any stock after the grace period, the company said.

Acquisition targets must have total revenues of at least $100 million and after-tax net income of at least $5 million. Certain other conditions are required including complete due diligence, it added.
International Equity said it has been seeking a business merger or an acquisition for several years.
